otallaka: [ava + talla + ka] (ti) CL=7 (1) Inferior. One who is inferior and without power. (2) One who wears a faded cloth, is poor and lonely.
otama: [ava + tamu + a] (pu) CL=7 Pitch-black darkness. See below.
otamasika: [otama + ika. ] (ti) CL=7 Reaches in the pitch-black darkness. One who is in the pitch-black darkness.
otappati: [ava + tapa + bha + ti] (kri) CL=7 He worries or becomes warm or burns.
otara: [ava + tara + hi] (kri) CL=7 May you come down. See - Otarati (A).
[ava + tara + a] (kri) CL=7 A place of descending. See below.
otaramāna: [ava + tara + a + māna] (ti) CL=7 (A) One who comes down. (A river) flows (into).
otaranta: [ava + tara + anta. ] (ti) CL=7 [In thī otarantī.] (A) One who descends or comes down. (B) One who flows down or is absorbed (by the power of reciting, etc.,).
otaranti: [ava + tara + a + anti] (kri) CL=7 (A) He flows down. (B) He enters or absorbs. (C) He flows down. See - Otarati (A)(B)(C).
otarantu: [ava + tara + a + antu] (kri) CL=7 May you (pl) come or flow down. See - Otarati(A).
otaratha: [ava + tara + a + tha] (kri) CL=7 May you go down or flow down. See - Otarati (A).
otarati: [va + tara + a + ti] (kri) CL=7 (A) He comes down. (B) (He) goes down. He gathers. (C) He flows down.
otaratu: [ava + tara + a + tu] (kri) CL=7 May he go or flow down. See - Otarati (A).
otarayitabba: [ava + tara + ṇaya + tabba] (ti) CL=7 Should be caused to come down.
otaraṇa: [ava + tara + yu] (thī, na) CL=7 (1) Causes to enter. Initiate. (Na) (2) Comes down. (3) A wrong view or doctrine that is poison. (Pu) (4) (Hāra) that causes to initiate or enter. (Ti) (5) (A period of) coming down. (6) Should be put down. (7) Entered.
otaraṇahāra: [otaraṇa + hāra] (pu) CL=7 Hāra which has the sign of putting the dhammas ( that comes from sutta) into khandhā, āyatana, dhāta, indriya, paṭiccasamuppāda, etc. Otaraṇahāra.
otaraṇahāravibhaṅga: [otaraṇahāra + vibhaṅga] (pu) CL=7 A commentary that is an analytical description of Otaraṇahāra.
otaraṇakicca: [otaraṇa + kicca] (na) CL=7 The function of descending.
otaraṇakiṭikā: [otaraṇā + kiṭikā] (thī) CL=7 A plate or wood or metal (that is a door or window which is hinged at the top) that is hung down.
otaraṇakāla: [otaraṇa + kāla] (pu) CL=7 A period of descending.
otaraṇalakkhaṇa: [otaraṇa + lakkhaṇa] (ti) CL=7 With the sign of entering or initiation.
otaraṇapakāra: [otaraṇa + pakāra] (pu) CL=7 The way of coming down or descending.
otaraṇatittha: [otaraṇa + tittha] (na) CL=7 A bathing port where (people) come down.
otaraṇavisiṭṭha: [otaraṇa + visiṭṭha] (ti) CL=7 Specialized by putting into.
otaraṇaṭṭhāna: [otaraṇa + ṭhāna] (na) CL=7 A descending place or a place where (someone) comes down or descends.
otaraṇānotaraṇavinicchaya: [otaraṇānotaraṇa + vinicchaya] (pu) CL=7 Discriminates for descending or not.
otaraṇārahaṭṭhāna: [otaraṇāraha + ṭhāna] (na) CL=7 A place where is worthy to descend.
otaraṇī: [(ava + tara + yu=) otaraṇa + ī (itthī paccaññaḥ.)] (thī) CL=7 (A river) that flows (into the ocean).

otaraṭṭhāna: [otara + ṭhāna] (na) CL=7 A place of descending or a place where (someone) descends.
otareyya: [ata + tara + eyya] (kri) CL=7 He should descend or come down. See - Otarati (A).
otari: [ava + tara + ī] (kri) CL=7 He went down or he flowed down. See - Otarati (A).
otarissati: [ava + tara + ssati] (kri) CL=7 He will descend (into). See - Otarati (A).
otarissāmi: [ata + tara + ssāmi] (kri) CL=7 I will descend or come down. See - Otarati (A).
otarita: [ava + tara + ta] (ti) CL=7 Descended or came down.
otaritabba: [ava + tara + tabba] (na) CL=7 (1) Should go down. Should go out. (Ti) (2) Should be come down. (3) Should be put into.
otarituṃ: [ava + tara + tuṃ] (bya) CL=7 (1) To descend (into). (2) To come down and crossover.
otariṃsu: [ava + tara + uuṃ] (kri) CL=7 They went down or flowed down. See - Otarati (A).
otaruṃ: [ata + tara + uuṃ] (kri) CL=7 They descended or went down. See - Otarati(A).
otarāhi: [ava + tara + a + hi] (kri) CL=7 May you come or flow down. See - Otarati (A).
otarāmi: [ava + tara + a + mi] (kri) CL=7 I come or flow down. See - Otarati (A).
otata: [ava + tanu + ta. ] (ti) CL=7 [Avatata(saṃ)] Should be overspread and formed.
otatavitata: [otata + vitata] (ti) CL=7 Should be overspread and formed in all directions.
otatta: [ava + tapa + ta] (ti) CL=7 Causes to burn.
otiṇthamalla: [otiṇṇa + malla] (pu) CL=7 A wrestler who goes or immerses (into).
otiṇthasatta: [otiṇṇa + satta] (pu) CL=7 Living beings who are descending (from).
otiṇṇa: [ava + tara + ta. ] (ti) CL=7 [Avatīṇaṃ] (1) One who goes down (into). (2) Gone down (into). One who comes down. (3) Flowed. (4) A place of going down. (5) Should be spoken or preached.
otiṇṇabhavaṅga: [otiṇṇa + bhavaṅga] (na) CL=7 A sub-consciousness that goes down (into).
otiṇṇabrahma: [otiṇṇa + brahma] (pu) CL=7 A brahma who is a descendant (from) or a brahma who is descending.
otiṇṇacitta: [otiṇṇa + citta] (ti) CL=7 One who has a mind that is swamped (by lust).
otiṇṇaghana: [otiṇṇa + ghana] (pu, na) CL=7 A solid that is falling down.
otiṇṇahatthī: [otiṇṇa + hatthī] (pu) CL=7 An elephant that descends.
otiṇṇakāla: [otiṇṇa + kāla] (pu) CL=7 A period of coming down or descending.

otiṇṇamūla: [otiṇṇa + mūla] (na) CL=7 The root that goes downward.
otiṇṇanadī: [otiṇṇā + nadī] (thī) CL=7 The river that flows.
otiṇṇapada: [otiṇṇa + pada] (na) CL=7 Footprints of one who is walking or coming.
otiṇṇapubba: [otiṇṇa + pubba] (ti) CL=7 One who has been affected in the past.
otiṇṇasadda: [otiṇṇa + sadda] (pu) CL=7 The word - Otiṇṇa. See - Otiṇṇa (1) (2).
otiṇṇasamaya: [otiṇṇa + samaya] (pu) CL=7 An occasion of descending or going down.
otiṇṇasākhā: [otiṇṇā + sākhā] (thī) CL=7 A branch (of a tree) that bends downward.
otiṇṇatittha: [otiṇṇa + tittha] (na) CL=7 A bathing place where (people) come down.
otiṇṇaudaka: [otiṇṇa + udaka] (na) CL=7 Flowing water or the water stream.
otiṇṇavatthuka: [otiṇṇa + vatthu + ka] (ti) CL=7 One who has an affair that should be overcome.
otiṇṇavatthuvisaya: [otiṇṇavatthu + visaya]  CL=9 Having the field- manner that is the cause- story which is descended- entered- transgressed.
otiṇṇavācāvatthu: [otiṇṇavācā + vatthu] (na) CL=7 The subject that is words (sound) that comes down and should be spoken.
otiṇṇavādasaṅgāma: [otiṇṇavāda + saṅgāma] (ti) CL=7 One who has a war of a doctrine that arises.
otiṇṇaṭṭhāna: [otiṇṇa + ṭhāna] (na) CL=7 Place of descending or a place where (someone or something) falls down in this place.
otiṇṇotiṇṇaṭṭhāna: [otiṇṇotiṇṇa + ṭhāna] (na) CL=7 Place of descending or a place where (someone or something) falls down in this place.
ottapana: [ava(u) + tapa + yu] (na) CL=7 Fear (for doing unwholesome deeds). See below.

ottappagārava: [ottappa + gārava] (ti) CL=7 One who respects in ottappa dhamma.

ottappamāna: [ava(u)+tapa+ya+māna] (ti) CL=7 One who is afraid of wrongdoing or one who fears for doing unwholesome deeds.
ottappamānasabhāva: [ottappamāna + sabhā0] (ti) CL=7 One who has a behavior of being afraid of wrongdoing.
ottappaniddesa: [ottappa + niddesa] (pu) CL=7 A phrase that is an analytical description of ottappa dhamma. See - Ottappati.
ottappanta: [ava(u)+tapa+ya+anta] (ti) CL=7 One who fears (for doing unwholesome deeds).

ottapparahita: [ottappa + rahita] (ti) CL=7 Free from shame in wrongdoing.
ottappasantāsabhaya: [ottappasantāsa + bhaya] (pu, na) CL=7 The danger of fear (for doing unwholesome deeds) or the danger that is shame (in wrongdoing).
ottappati: [ava(u) + tapa + ya + ti.] (kri) CL=7 [Nīti, dhā. 122. Dhātvattha. 156.] He fears for doing unwholesome deeds.

ottareyya: [ava + thara + eyya] (kri) CL=7 (A) Should cover and mesh in all directions.
ottaṭokāsa: [otthaṭa + okāsa] (pu, na) CL=7 A place or region that should be covered.

Bhāsā, ṭī. 151.]  A water filter that should sunk in water and filter water. (bhāsā, ṭī, 151.)  A water filter that is placed on water and filters water. Bhāsā, ṭī. 545.) A big water filter that is spread over the water and filters water.
ottharanta: [ava + thara + a + anta. ] (ti) CL=7 [In thī ottharantī.] Should be covered and meshed over in all directions.
ottharanti: [ava + thara + a + anti] (kri) CL=7 (A) They spread over. (B) They afflict. See - Ottharati (A) (B).

ottharitvā: [ava + thara + tvā] (kri, vi) CL=7 (A) Having pressed. Having stepped on. (B) Having overwhelmed. Having covered. (C) Having sunk.
otthariyamāna: [ava + thara + ya + māna] (ti) CL=7 One who should be oppressed.

otthariyyati: [ava + thara + ya + te] (kamma, kri) CL=7 (He) should be spread over in all directions.

otthaṭapatta: [ottaṭa + patta] (pu) CL=7 A monk bowl that should be covered.
ottāpa: [ata(u) + tapa + ṇa] (pu) CL=7 The dhamma that shames wrongdoing or the dhamma that fears for doing unwholesome deeds. See - Ottāpī.
ottāparahita: [ottāpa + rahita] (ti) CL=7 One who is free from fear of wrongdoing.
ottāpī: [ottāpa + ī] (ti) CL=7 One who fears for doing unwholesome deeds.
ottāsa: [ava(u) + tasa + ṇa] (pu) CL=7 Fear (for doing unwholesome deeds). See below.
ottāsalakkhaṇa: [ottāsa + lakkhaṇa] (ti) CL=7 With the sign of fear (for wrongdoing).
otu: [ava + tu.] (pu) CL=7 [Vi, pi, dhāna. Otu (saṃ)] A cat. See -  e 2.

otāpitasuddhavattha: [otāpita + suddhavattha] (ti) CL=7 One who has a white cloth that should be put in the sun to dry.
otāra: [ava + tara + ṇa] (pu) CL=7 (1) Comes into. Goes into. Descending. Putting (into). (2) A hole. Intervening space. An occasion of arising. A chance. A cause of arising.
otāralābha: [otāra + lābha] (pu) CL=7 Has a chance. Causes to get an opportunity.
otārayati: [ava + tara + ṇaya + ti] (kā, kri) CL=7 (1) Causes to strive. (2) Causes to come down.

otārayitabba: [ava + tara + ṇaya + tabba]  CL=9 That is mounted- inserted- put.
otārayiṃsu: [ava + tara + ṇaya + uuṃ] (kā, kri) CL=7 They caused to descend or come down. See - Otārayati (2).
otāraṇa: [ava + tara + ṇe + yu] (na) CL=7 Causes to come down or causes to affect. Puts down.  Puts into. Causes to close together.
otārehi: [ava + tara + ṇe + hi] (kā, kri) CL=7 May you set adrift. See - Otāreti (C).
otāremi: [ava + tara + ṇe + mi] (kā, kri) CL=7 I cause to enter down. See - Otāreti (A).
otārenta: [ava + tara + ṇe + anta] (ti) CL=7 One who causes to bring down.
otārenti: [ava + tara + ṇe + anti] (kā, kri) CL=7 They cause to bring down. See - Otāreti (B). (B) They set adrift. See - Otāreti (C).
otāresi: [ava + tara + ṇe + ī] (kā, kri) CL=7 He caused to enter down. See - Otāreti (A).
otāresuṃ: [ava + tara + ṇe + uuṃ] (kā, kri) CL=7 They caused to enter down. See - Otāreti (A).

otāreyyuṃ: [ava + tara + ṇe + eyyuṃ] (kā, kri) CL=7 They should cause to enter down. See - Otāreti (A).
otārita: [ava + tara + ṇe + ta] (ti) CL=7 Caused to descend. Caused to fall or put (down).
otāriyamāna: [ava + tara + ya + ṇe + māna] (ti) CL=7 Should be put (into). Should be placed (down).

otārālābha: [otāra + alābha] (pu) CL=7 Doesn"t get a chance or an opportunity.
otārāpekkha: [otāra + apekkha] (ti) CL=7 Looking for an opening or longing for an opportunity.
otārāpetvā: [ava + tara + ṇāpe + tvā] (kri, vi) CL=7 Having caused to descend. Having caused to fall. Having put down.
otārīyati: [ava + tara + ṇe + ya + te] (kamma, kri) CL=7 Should cause to go (into) or should put into or should place down.
otaritu: [ava + tara + tuṃ] (bya) CL=7 (1) To descend (into). (2) To come down and crossover.
otarisu: [ava + tara + uuṃ] (kri) CL=7 They went down or flowed down. See - Otarati (A).
otaru: [ata + tara + uuṃ] (kri) CL=7 They descended or went down. See - Otarati(A).
otāpetu: [ava + tapa + ṇe + tuṃ] (bya) CL=7 To dry or sun or to put in the sun to dry.
otārayisu: [ava + tara + ṇaya + uuṃ] (kā, kri) CL=7 They caused to descend or come down. See - Otārayati (2).
otāresu: [ava + tara + ṇe + uuṃ] (kā, kri) CL=7 They caused to enter down. See - Otāreti (A).
otāretu: [ava + tara + ṇe + tuṃ] (bya) CL=7 To cause to go into.
otāreyyu: [ava + tara + ṇe + eyyuṃ] (kā, kri) CL=7 They should cause to enter down. See - Otāreti (A).
